name: hud_stack_party_strip_marks
description: With company a stacked call is everyone's (M8, design 2.7: 'the party strip shows Ready marks during a wave too'): during wave 1 of High Water the party strip shows a Ready mark on each plate, my call lights my bead and the strip counts 'Ready 1/2' after the creeps left, and the call waits for the partner: nothing sets out until the partner's call lands, and then its horn sounds at once and clears every Ready. With two on the road a third may still be called, so the marks stay, none lit; with three on the road none can, and the marks go. In classic a wave shows no marks, as before.

steps.assert: node('PartyStrip').ready_marks_shown() == 2 and not node('PartyStrip').lines()[0].ends_with('ready') and not node('Countdown').text.contains('Ready')
steps.msg: in a wave that may stack, both plates show a mark, none lit; the strip counts nobody yet
my call lights my bead and the strip counts it

steps.assert: Game.wave == 1 and Game.is_ready() and node('Countdown').text.ends_with('· Ready 1/2')
steps.msg: my call waits for the partner: half a second on, nothing has set out and the strip still counts 1/2

steps.assert: Game.waves_on_road() == PackedInt32Array([1, 2]) and not Game.is_ready() and not scene.sim.seat(2).ready
steps.msg: the partner's call lands and the horn sounds at once, clearing every Ready

steps.assert: node('PartyStrip').ready_marks_shown() == 2 and not node('PartyStrip').lines()[0].ends_with('ready') and not node('PartyStrip').lines()[1].ends_with('ready') and not node('Countdown').text.contains('Ready')
steps.msg: with two on the road a third may be called: the marks stay, none lit

steps.assert: Game.waves_on_road() == PackedInt32Array([1, 2, 3]) and not Game.is_ready() and not scene.sim.seat(2).ready and node('PartyStrip').ready_marks_shown() == 0
steps.msg: with three on the road no call can be made, and the marks go
classic never stacks: no marks in a wave, the horn greyed
